customManagers.description: Docker images referenced directly in Nomad job specs (not a format Renovate recognizes natively)
Keycloak release tarball, checksum-pinned in an artifact block - PRs from this manager need a manual checksum update, see packageRules note
Lidarr release tarball, checksum-pinned in an artifact block - PRs from this manager need a manual checksum update, see packageRules note
slskd release zip, checksum-pinned in an artifact block - PRs from this manager need a manual checksum update, see packageRules note
Semaphore release tarball, checksum-pinned in the semaphore job's bootstrap script (not a native artifact block) - PRs from this manager need a manual checksum update, see packageRules note

prBodyNotes: This manager only tracks the release version - it can't recompute the sha256 checksum the job spec's `artifact`/bootstrap script verifies against. Do **not** merge this PR as-is: use it as a signal that a release exists, then update the download URL and checksum by hand (download the new release, compute its sha256, update both in the `.nomad.hcl` file), same as past version bumps recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
